function.name: past_sessions
function.description: Read the user's other saved sessions, read-only. Without session: find sessions by name and the titles of what they hold. With session: what it holds. With item: read that item. With copy: bring it into this session's scratch/ or as a new table or file here. Only results are shared (tables, charts, reports, files), never a session's conversation or notes.

query.description: Words matched against session names and the titles of their tables, charts and reports. Omit for the most recent sessions.

session.description: A session id from a previous result, or its name.

item.description: tables/<name>, charts/<id>, reports/<id> or files/<path>, as past_sessions(session) lists them; or a list of up to 10.

rows.description: For a table: the rows to read, e.g. "1-50".

columns.description: For a table: only these columns.

offset.description: For a text file or report: the first line to read.

copy.description: scratch: a copy for code under scratch/past/<session>/. session: a new table or file in this session, with provenance naming the session it came from.
